name: Battle Planner (Mythic)
body:
Your allies move on the battlefield as an all-consuming force, following your precise directives.

Prerequisite(s): Battle Planner.

Benefit(s): You can use your inspire action class feature on all allies within 60 feet. If you possess the mythic inspire action class feature, this applies to it too.
